Harbor Coverage

8 January 2027

Morgan Ibarra
Desk supervisor
Northline Access Collaborative
Vancouver desk
British Columbia

Dear Morgan Ibarra,

This letter is the coverage reply from Harbor Coverage on referral REF-4417. I am Ruth Alvarez, a clerk in the correspondence unit. I am writing to you because you supervise the Vancouver desk, and the inquiry we answered names that desk as the office to receive the reply. Please keep this letter with the referral. The sentences below are the reply. They are meant to be read as a whole.

The answer is yes.

The currency on this reply is CAD. Harbor Coverage keeps accounts in CAD and in USD. The currency named for REF-4417 in this letter is CAD. A reader who needs the currency of this reply should take it from this paragraph, where it is written as CAD.

The member region on this reply is BC. The inquiry that produced this letter described the member as a British Columbia member. This reply records that region as BC. I am not restating a street address, a phone number, or a clinic chart. The region field on the reply is BC.

The effective window on this reply runs from 2027-01-12 through 2027-04-12. Harbor's record of that window uses these instants: effective from 2027-01-12T00:00:00Z, effective through 2027-04-12T00:00:00Z. Those two instants are the start and the end written on this reply. The answer yes, the currency CAD, the member region BC, and this window belong together. Lifting the word yes off the page and leaving the window behind would no longer be the reply I signed.

Harbor's record time for this reply is 2027-01-08T16:00:00Z. That is the time on the coverage record I am confirming in letter form. If your file already has a coverage row for REF-4417, this letter is the correspondence that goes with the answer, the currency, the region, and the window stated above. If a later copy of the row omits one of those fields, the letter is still the place where I wrote them down.

This unit prepares a reply of this kind only when a clerk has an answer to send. The letter names the referral, states the answer, states the currency, states the member region, and states the window. It is addressed to a person who can file it at the desk that asked. I have addressed it to you for that reason. You may show it to the operations director if your desk practice requires a supervisor's copy. I am not asking you to rewrite it into a shorter slogan for a screen. The reply is the text in this letter.

A coverage letter from this unit does not describe a clinic night file, a handset, or a wait figure. Those subjects are outside the reply. Staff who need them will have to look at the offices that keep them. Nothing in the paragraphs above should be copied into those subjects as if I had written them. I have written the answer, the currency, the member region, and the window.

Please file the letter under REF-4417 at the Vancouver desk, and keep the window dates with the answer. If someone at the desk asks you what Harbor said, the accurate report is the one in this letter: answer yes, currency CAD, member region BC, effective 2027-01-12 through 2027-04-12. A paraphrase that drops the window, or that swaps the currency, is not a second reply from me. I would have to send another letter to change any of those four points, and I have not sent another letter.

The footnote under my signature is standing language on Harbor correspondence. It sits on this letter because every reply from this unit carries it. It speaks to an inquiry for which no reply was sent. This letter is a reply that was sent. The answer on REF-4417 is the answer written above. The footnote does not erase that answer, and the answer does not erase the footnote. They do different work, and both are on the page.

I can answer a question about the words of this letter during the office week, Monday through Friday, at the correspondence unit. A question about a different referral needs its own reference. I will not treat a phone call about a different reference as an amendment to REF-4417.

Yours sincerely,

Ruth Alvarez
Clerk
Harbor Coverage
Correspondence unit
